text: The company reduced Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions through energy efficiency projects and increased renewable electricity procurement.
Water consumption intensity decreased while wastewater treatment and recycling capacity increased.
The company assessed biodiversity risks around operating sites and implemented ecosystem restoration measures.
Employees received occupational health and safety training and the company tracked lost time injury frequency.
The company maintains a human rights policy covering workers and key suppliers and conducts due diligence.
The board includes independent directors and the audit committee oversees financial reporting and risk management.
Manufacturing sites improved energy efficiency and increased the share of electricity sourced from renewable energy.
The company expanded diversity and inclusion programs and employee training.
The code of conduct covers anti-corruption, whistleblowing and regulatory compliance.
The company strengthened data privacy controls, cybersecurity processes and customer complaint management.
